findings.evidence: Membership is built by raw `AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨t * t', _, a * b, _, by ring⟩` at lines 212, 237 and 268-269; elimination is done by `rw [weightMul_def, AddSubgroup.closure_le]; rintro _ ⟨t, ht, u, hu, rfl⟩` at lines 264-265 and 270-271; `AddSubgroup.closure_induction` on `weightMul` membership at lines 206, 208, 234, 336.
findings.fix: Add `mul_mem_weightMul`, `weightMul_le` (and a `weightMul_induction` wrapper over `AddSubgroup.closure_induction`), and use them in place of the raw unfoldings inside the file.
findings.issue: `weightMul` has only the unfolding lemma `weightMul_def` (line 104): no introduction lemma (`t ∈ weightPow T ν → u ∈ U → t * u ∈ weightMul T ν U`), no elimination lemma (`weightMul T ν U ≤ V ↔ ∀ t ∈ weightPow T ν, ∀ u ∈ U, t * u ∈ V`), and no induction principle. Every consumer must unfold to `AddSubgroup.closure` and hand-build the pointwise-product witness.

findings.evidence: `AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds` exists in Mathlib (`Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/OpenSubgroup.lean:245`, additive version), so the upgrade is one line; the roadmap gates all of §0.4 and §5.2 on this hypothesis (`TauCetiRoadmap/AdicSpaces/README.md:205-211`, `:646`), so every later weight family must discharge it.
findings.fix: Add `IsWeightFamily.of_forall_openAddSubgroup` (check only `U : OpenAddSubgroup A`) and `IsWeightFamily.isOpen_weightMul` / a bundled `OpenAddSubgroup` accessor derived from `weightMul_mem_nhds`.
findings.issue: `IsWeightFamily` is phrased over arbitrary `U ∈ nhds 0` (line 116) while `IsWeightedRestricted` quantifies over `OpenAddSubgroup A` (line 163-165), and the elimination `IsWeightFamily.weightMul_mem_nhds` stops at `mem_nhds`. So a consumer can neither discharge the hypothesis by checking open subgroups only (which suffices: any `U ∈ nhds 0` contains an open subgroup `V`, and `closure (T i ^ m * V) ≤ closure (T i ^ m * U)`), nor feed `weightMul T ν U` back into `IsWeightedRestricted` without re-deriving its openness.

findings.evidence: The file itself must rewrite with it manually at line 283 (`rwa [weightMul_zero]`) and line 722 (`rw [weightMul_zero]`); `weightMul_def` is not a simp lemma, so no simp set reaches it.
findings.fix: Mark `weightMul_zero` `@[simp]` (and add a `@[simp] weightPow_zero : weightPow T 0 = {1}` alongside).
findings.issue: `weightMul_zero : weightMul T 0 U = U`, the base-case normal form that every constant-coefficient argument hits, is not `@[simp]`, while the far narrower `weightPow_one`/`weightMul_one` (lines 347, 354) are. Since `weightMul`'s body is unexposed, `simp` cannot discharge it any other way.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn ScaledTateTopology code/` returns exactly one hit, the docstring line itself; `TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/` contains only Basic, Bounded, PowerBounded, RestrictedPowerSeries, WeightedRestrictedSeries.
findings.fix: Drop the paragraph, or reword it to name the object (the scaled topology on the ordinary `A⟨X⟩`) without citing a module path that is not on `main`.
findings.issue: The module docstring tells readers this construction is "not `TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/ScaledTateTopology.lean`", but no such module exists in the repository, so the disambiguation points at nothing.

summary: The surface is minimal and free of compatibility artifacts, but the central definition `weightMul` ships without introduction or elimination lemmas, and the `IsWeightFamily` interface stops short of the `OpenAddSubgroup` form every consumer needs. Also a missing `@[simp]` on the base-case lemma and a docstring pointer to a nonexistent module.
